2.3.3  
    
    Example: Representing Sets
    例：集合の表現

child.body:
function adjoin_set(x, set) {
    return is_null(set)
           ? make_tree(x, null, null)
           : x === entry(set)
           ? set
           : x < entry(set)
           ? make_tree(entry(set),
                       adjoin_set(x, left_branch(set)),
                       right_branch(set))
           : // $\texttt{x > entry(set)}$
             make_tree(entry(set),
                       left_branch(set),
                       adjoin_set(x, right_branch(set)));
}
